description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Elpitiya, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District (25/5514129)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determination for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and encumbrances, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
